sourceGeometry: Original campus-data.json is unchanged: 58 building footprints, 75 road ways, 27 areas.
visualAdditions: Original 58 building footprints, 75 road centre lines and 27 land areas remain unchanged.

Entrance photograph reviewed again: wider main road, sidewalks, double yellow centre line, gate stonework, mature avenue trees and central booth reconstructed from visible features. Widths and placement remain estimates.
713+ illustrative trees in mapped woodland and parks and photo-informed avenue rows. Individual trees, streetlights, crossings, kerbs and planted details are not field surveyed.
Local photo-based CC0 materials from Poly Haven provide albedo, OpenGL normal and roughness maps at metre-based UV scale. These are general materials, not photographs taken at Jeju University.
Museum upper glazing and round columns, facade panel joints and signage are based on the recorded reference photo; unseen elevations remain approximate.
Generic building glazing, frames, sills, plinths and roof parapets are illustrative. Only gate, museum and former main building have photo-reviewed facade details.
Sky, clouds, lighting and flat terrain are reconstructed. No claim of photogrammetry, surveyed heights or a verified digital twin.
Optional first-person eye height 1.65 m. Tree trunks, gate piers, light poles and central booth have collision radii.
privacy: Walking stamps are stored only in local browser storage. No analytics, account, multiplayer, campaign, or remote collection endpoint is configured.
